name: compression-health
install_notes: Deploy staging/scripts/compression-health.sh into ~/.hermes/scripts/, install as a no_agent cron health tick, and run it in cron mode (--cron) so HEALTHY emits wakeAgent:false/silent while UNHEALTHY exits non-zero and routes loudly to #alerts. Use #logs only for manual/verbose health evidence, not for OK spam. If the current cron runner cannot pass script args directly, install a tiny live wrapper that execs compression-health.sh --cron and register that wrapper as the no_agent script.
write_scope: staging-only registration; main deploy copies staging to live after review
